description: This file defines a base class for strategies that determine when a user has stopped speaking within a speech processing system. It includes data structures for parameters emitted upon user turn stoppage and provides abstract methods to be implemented by subclasses for processing incoming frames, managing event handlers, and signaling user turn cessation.

classes.name: UserTurnStoppedParams
classes.description: Data class encapsulating parameters emitted when a user turn stops, indicating whether to enable user speaking frames.

classes.name: BaseUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Abstract base class for implementing user turn stop detection strategies, managing event handling, and interfacing with task management components.

methods.name: __init__(self, *, enable_user_speaking_frames: bool = True, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with optional enabling of user speaking frames and registers relevant event handlers.

methods.name: BaseTaskManager task_manager(self)
methods.description: Property accessor for the associated task manager; raises RuntimeError if not set.

methods.name: setup(self, task_manager: BaseTaskManager)
methods.description: Associates a task manager with this strategy instance.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations; to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the strategy; to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame to determine if the user has stopped speaking; intended for subclass implementation.

methods.name: push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection = FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM)
methods.description: Emits an event to push a frame downstream via the event handler.

methods.name: broadcast_frame(self, frame_cls: Type[Frame], **kwargs)
methods.description: Broadcasts a frame of specified class with optional parameters via event handler.

methods.name: trigger_user_turn_stopped(self)
methods.description: Triggers an event indicating the user turn has stopped, passing relevant parameters.
